definition: An immutable closure of source code and dependencies, identified by a unique URI, used as the atomic unit of deployment.
A pinned context for a client request, binding it to a specific AbilityGeneration and its associated runtime snapshot.
A lifecycle state where a generation no longer accepts new requests but remains warm until all existing pinned sessions are released.
A single, immutable source file produced by the RuntimeBundleBuilder from a set of interdependent .cls files.
A detached, immutable snapshot of the environment, module, and generation used to execute a specific operation.
An immutable configuration mapping client identities to runtime bindings, granted abilities, and logical resources.
